title: Invoices from before 29 Jul 2026 stay Unassigned on both sides
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Location-A} has invoices dated before 29 Jul 2026.
    For example: invoices from June 2026.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set a date range before 29 Jul 2026 that holds invoices.
  2. Turn Show Unassigned on.
  3. Turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
  4. Read the rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report shows the range.
  • Step 2: Show Unassigned is on.
  • Step 3: a Sales Type column shows.
  • Step 4: those invoices are credited to Unassigned on both sides; no representative has been added to them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-E2: “Every invoice created before the release has its one representative on both sides, so the report for any past date reads exactly as before, with that person's Labor and Parts rows shown as one "Labor, Parts" row (S5-R10). Invoices created before 2026-07-29 have no representative recorded; they stay Unassigned on both sides, and none is added.”
